action.confirmation: Start a new game? This replaces the current position.

bindings.name: board
bindings.expr: constants.indices.map(i, i == action.source || (chosen.jump && i == chosen.middle) ? 0 : i == action.target ? (promoted ? 2 * state.turn : state.board[action.source]) : state.board[i])

action.name: "reset"
action.confirmation: Start a new game? This replaces the current position.

props.text: state.winner != 0 ? sideName(state.winner) + " wins" : state.draw ? "Draw — quiet-turn limit reached" : sideName(state.turn) + " to move" + (state.forced >= 0 ? " · continue the jump" : "")

props.label: coordinate(cell) + (state.board[cell] == 0 ? " empty" : " " + sideName(state.board[cell] > 0 ? 1 : -1) + (state.board[cell] == 2 || state.board[cell] == -2 ? " king" : " piece"))

action.name: cell in targets ? "move" : "select"
action.arguments:
cell in targets ? {"source": state.selected,
"target": cell} : {"index": cell}
